name: Pain
body:
Design destruction; Level 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect ray
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a ray of painful, razor-sharp energy from your pointing finger. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack with the ray to hit. The ray deals 1d4 points of slashing damage on a hit.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, it deals an additional 1d4 points of damage.
